title: A NotHeld Resume's renewed budget window is only stamped, not committed with the Resume
outcome: In release_engram_begin_preparation_hold_for_resume's NotHeld branch (src/engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs ~:979), an ended or spent budget window replaced by an accepted Resume is made durable in the same write as that Resume, as the Releasable paths already are. Alternatively, docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md says that this path stamps the new window and lets the drain's commit carry it. Today it only stamps, so a drain that refuses without committing, or a stop before the next save, leaves the saved state with the old ended window while memory has the new one. At worst that costs an extra Resume after a restart. A test covers whichever behaviour is chosen.
acceptance: A NotHeld Resume's renewed budget window is only stamped, not committed with the Resume is done
